settings.title: Parking and access sorted
settings.text: A quick note about parking or loading docks keeps your pickup on time and your price accurate.

settings.question: How much does furniture pickup and delivery cost in Sydney?
settings.answer: It depends on the item, the two suburbs, stairs or lifts and timing. We give a fixed price before you book. Send your details or call 0469 717 535.

settings.question: Can you pick up furniture today?
settings.answer: Often, yes. We work 7am to 7pm, 7 days. Call or send your request early and we'll confirm the earliest time.

settings.question: Do you move just one item?
settings.answer: Yes. Single items are most of our work: one couch, one bed or one fridge, with no minimum job size.

settings.question: Can you collect from a Facebook Marketplace or Gumtree seller?
settings.answer: Yes. Send us the listing and the seller's suburb. We arrange a time with the seller, collect the item and deliver it to you.

settings.question: Do you pick up from IKEA and furniture stores?
settings.answer: Yes. We collect from IKEA Tempe, Rhodes and Marsden Park, and from furniture stores and warehouses across Sydney.

settings.question: Is my furniture insured?
settings.answer: Yes. Your items are covered while they're in our care, wrapped in blankets and strapped in the van.

settings.local_heading: How Our Furniture Pickup Service Works
settings.local_body:
Most of our jobs are one item or a small load: a couch from a Marketplace seller, a bed from a store, a fridge from a friend's place. We collect it, wrap it in blankets, strap it in the van and place it in the room you choose.

You get a fixed price before we start, based on the item, the two suburbs and any stairs or lifts. No hourly meter, no surprises.
